title: Islamophobia: attitudes towards Muslims and the Islam among young people in the Netherlands in 2006
authors: Prof. dr. Henk Dekker (Project leader, Leiden University, Department of Political Science)
Drs. Jolanda van der Noll (Researcher, Leiden University, Department of Political Science)
contributors: Dr. Tereza Capelos (Methodology consultant, Leiden University, Department of Political Science)
descriptions: The research objective of this survey was to get insight in the origins of Islamophobia. The survey was held among 581 non-Islamic boys and girls, between 14 and 16 years, from 33 third year secondary school classes of 11 schools in the Netherlands.
